scope: mechanism-equivalent fictional bee cases, not official CAIL2018 discovery/legal benchmark
mechanism: Training observations -> live factor discovery -> fixed schema -> live per-case extraction -> training-only imputation/scaling/KMeans -> prototype action/outcome statistics -> heldout nearest prototype and limited narrative.
leakage_controls: Heldout observations never used for factor discovery, fitting imputation/scaler/clusters/tree, or prototype statistics. Training actions/outcomes excluded from discovery/extraction prompts, used only after features exist. Heldout action labels excluded from model reports and feature extraction.

importance_target: Training recorded-action labels; predictive association in authored data, not causal factor weights.
